aph-6b19466162.s: What is the evidence that Narayanabhattu helped Nannayabhattu in the process of translation of the Mahabharata?
aph-6b19466162.x: The Nandampudi inscription records Rajaraja Narendra's grant of Nandampudi village to Narayanabhatta, Nannaya's associate in translating the Mahabharata.

aph-f53f8de457.s: Which Andhra dynasty issued iron coins with a thin copper coating?

aph-c60dfd3d68.s: Who gets the credit for keeping Telugu in the history of Andhra?
aph-c60dfd3d68.x: Although the Vengi (Eastern) Chalukyas used Sanskrit as their official language, Telugu language and literature developed significantly under them.

aph-d2f4276b0a.s: Religion and politics became non-Brahmin during which dynasty's rule in Andhradesa?
aph-d2f4276b0a.x: The Kakatiya rulers were themselves non-Brahmins (Shudras), and the period is called the age of the Shudras.

aph-bd14f361a8.s: Which king collected the Puriti tax?
aph-bd14f361a8.x: Rachavema, the last Kondaveedu Reddy king, became unpopular by imposing oppressive taxes and, according to the Kondaveeti Kaifiyat, was killed as a tyrant.

aph-cd6fa112ca.s: Which was an important port in coastal Andhra where shipbuilding was actively carried on during the 16th and 17th centuries?
aph-cd6fa112ca.x: Narsapuram (West Godavari) was a major shipbuilding centre in the 16th-17th centuries; Methold notes large, strongly built ships there under the Qutb Shahis.

aph-f8af8811ca.s: Who acted as negotiator between Nizam Ali Khan, Nawab of Hyderabad, and the East India Company's representatives at Machilipatnam in obtaining the lease of the Northern Circars for the Company?
aph-f8af8811ca.x: After Shah Alam II's 1765 grant of the Northern Circars, the British sent Kandregula Jogi Pantulu as mediator to Nizam Ali, leading to the 1766 treaty.

aph-b563c884da.s: Which of the following famines was the worst in the southern country?
aph-b563c884da.x: The Guntur famine of 1833 (the 'Nandana' famine) was the most severe, described vividly by Captain Walter Campbell.

aph-f0dc0d5415.s: Who established the first Prarthana Samaj in Andhra in 1878?
aph-f0dc0d5415.x: Kandukuri Veeresalingam founded the first Prarthana Samaj in Andhra at Rajahmundry in 1878.

aph-6e16654696.s: A great dancer who performed the Kuravanji dance?
aph-6e16654696.x: Rukmini Devi Arundale was a famous exponent of Kuravanji, a Tamil folk dance-drama with classical elements.

aph-df6633e702.s: The advent of united Andhra Pradesh took place after?
o: Hyderabad State Chief Minister Burgula Ramakrishna Rao agreed
K.V. Ranga Reddy and M. Chenna Reddy agreed
A unanimous resolution of Andhra State for Vishalandhra was passed
aph-df6633e702.x: The Gentlemen's Agreement of 20 February 1956 gave safeguards to Telangana, after which Andhra Pradesh was formed on 1 November 1956.

aph-f8c3afa843.why: Stem and options are fragments of answer explanations from other questions.

aph-3e29b5d05e.s: The king who bore the title of 'Kavi Vatsala'?
aph-3e29b5d05e.x: Hala, the Satavahana king who compiled the Gathasaptasati, bore the title 'Kavi Vatsala'.

aph-d867b435d2.s: Inculcating religious thought in the minds of disciples as the duty of teachers is found in which inscription of Ashoka?
aph-d867b435d2.x: The Erragudi edicts of Ashoka state that it is the duty of gurus to inculcate spiritual thought in their disciples.

aph-63ba0fce9b.s: During whose reign did Buddhism receive great patronage in the Ikshvaku kingdom?
aph-63ba0fce9b.x: Nagarjunakonda inscriptions show that Buddhism flourished under Veerapurushadatta with the patronage of the royal women of his family.

aph-f28a018d78.s: The Chaitya referred to as Siddharthaka Chaitya in Buddhist literature was identified as being at?
aph-f28a018d78.x: Among the Chaityaka branches: Purvasaila - Dhanyakataka, Uttarasaila - Jaggayyapeta, Rajagirika - Guntupalli, Siddharthika - Gudivada.

aph-8ad803ff1c.s: Which Chalukya king built 108 Shiva temples named Narendra Mrigeswaralayas?
aph-8ad803ff1c.x: Vijayaditya-II (Narendra Mrigaraja) fought 108 battles in twelve years and built 108 Shiva temples as penance.

aph-31d7977994.s: Which king is said to have developed Kandukuru like Bezawada?
aph-31d7977994.x: Vijayaditya-III (Gunaga Vijayaditya) built Pandurangapuram and developed Kandukuru as a town on the lines of Bezawada.

aph-4cc82dafd6.s: Bhairavakona in Nellore district was a centre of?
aph-4cc82dafd6.x: Bhairavakona is known for its rock-cut Shiva cave temples.

aph-9b631da7e9.s: Where are the Navabrahma temples located?
aph-9b631da7e9.x: The Navabrahma temples at Alampur, on the Tungabhadra, are a group of nine early Badami Chalukyan Shiva temples, regarded as the western gateway of Srisailam.

aph-37da2b7370.s: Who received Navakhandavada from Rajaraja Narendra?
aph-37da2b7370.x: Pavuluri Mallana translated Mahaviracharya's Sanskrit Ganitasarasangraha into Telugu and was granted the agrahara Navakhandavada.

aph-1ac278b5c0.s: Which inscription describes the military victories of Gautamiputra Satakarni?
aph-1ac278b5c0.x: The Nashik Prasasti, issued by his mother Gautami Balasri in the 19th regnal year of Pulumavi, records Gautamiputra's victories.

aph-612d4642a9.s: Commentaries on the Vedas were written under the leadership of Sayana and Madhava during whose period?
aph-612d4642a9.x: Sayanacharya (Vedartha Prakasa) and Madhavacharya wrote their Vedic commentaries during the period of Harihara-II.

aph-df8b69dc40.s: The English East India Company established a factory in the town of Machilipatnam. Who allowed the company to do that?
aph-df8b69dc40.x: The English factory at Machilipatnam (1611) was set up with the permission of the Golconda Sultan Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah.

aph-a9dbff3108.s: During the rebellion of 1857 an attempt was made to incite rebellion in a town in Rayalaseema. Which town was it?
aph-a9dbff3108.x: Sheikh Peer Saheb tried to incite rebellion at Kadapa in 1857 and was arrested by the police.

aph-f9a84b5555.s: The practice of Satavahana kings prefixing their personal names with their mothers' names started during whose period?
aph-f9a84b5555.x: The tradition of kings prefixing their mother's name (metronymics) began with Gautamiputra Satakarni.
aph-f9a84b5555.key: corrected: metronymic names began with Gautamiputra Satakarni, not Hala

aph-df7adb70b0.x: The Jain teacher Kundakundacharya preached the Syadvada doctrine.

aph-28dc394516.s: Who among the following is recognized as the founder of Satavahana rule?
aph-28dc394516.x: Simukha (Srimukha) founded Satavahana rule; Gautamiputra Satakarni was the greatest and Pulumavi-III the last.

aph-f3cc0c67cc.s: Where was the English Fort St. George built?
aph-f3cc0c67cc.x: Francis Day built Fort St. George at Madraspatnam in 1639-40.

aph-e94142564e.s: Where did Acharya N.G. Ranga establish the first Kisan school?
aph-e94142564e.x: In 1934 N.G. Ranga established the Bharatiya Kisan school at Nidubrolu, Guntur district.

aph-ce03e812b6.s: The Justice Party was formed to further whose interests?
aph-ce03e812b6.x: The Justice Party (1916-17), founded by C. Natesa Mudaliar, T.M. Nair and others, opposed Brahmin dominance in politics, education and jobs.

aph-d05dba6c8a.s: On which day did Kandukuri Veeresalingam perform the first widow remarriage?
aph-d05dba6c8a.x: On 11 December 1881 Veeresalingam performed the first widow remarriage, of Gogulapati Sriramulu and Seethamma, at Rajahmundry.

aph-f06a0c37d2.s: Identify the scholar who argued that the Satavahanas were not Andhras.
aph-f06a0c37d2.x: Sukthankar argued that the Satavahanas were not Andhras and placed their original home in the Kannada (Bellary) region.

aph-6c76ffa3ed.s: Where was the Ryotwari system first introduced in the Madras Presidency?
aph-6c76ffa3ed.x: Alexander Read with Thomas Munro first introduced the Ryotwari system of revenue collection in Baramahal.

aph-68ef715711.s: Who among the following kings built Rajahmundry?
aph-68ef715711.x: According to the book, Rajahmundry city was built by Ammaraja.

aph-1287a87e1c.s:
Arrange the following dynasties that ruled the Andhra region in chronological order:
a. Ikshvakus
b. Vishnukundins
c. Salankayanas
d. Brihatphalayanas
aph-1287a87e1c.x: Chronological order: Ikshvakus > Brihatphalayanas > Salankayanas > Vishnukundins.

aph-8efcf1174f.x: Hala compiled the Gathasaptasati in Maharashtri Prakrit.

aph-68a3db12ea.s: Bipin Chandra Pal visited the districts of Andhra during the Vande Mataram movement. Whose guest was he in Machilipatnam?
aph-68a3db12ea.x: Ramadas Naidu made the arrangements for Bipin Chandra Pal's stay at Machilipatnam during his 1907 Andhra tour.

aph-e9cc5e273a.s: Where was the High Court established when Andhra State was formed?
aph-e9cc5e273a.x: When Andhra State was formed in 1953, its High Court was set up at Guntur while the capital was Kurnool.

aph-452dfe8bd0.s: During Satavahana rule, the administration of what was carried out by the Nigama Sabhas?
aph-452dfe8bd0.x: Nigamas were towns; their corporate affairs were managed by Nigama Sabhas made up of gahapatis.

aph-40d24f9bdd.s: What does the Chanda Railway Scheme agitation in Hyderabad State represent?
o: Beginning of public consciousness in the state
aph-40d24f9bdd.x: The 1883 agitation against the Chanda Railway Scheme marked the beginning of public political consciousness in Hyderabad State.

aph-0f705a715e.s: Who founded the Sri Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam?
aph-0f705a715e.x: Komarraju Lakshmana Rao founded the Sri Krishnadevaraya Andhra Bhasha Nilayam in Hyderabad in 1901 at the residence of Ravichettu Ranga Rao.

aph-1277b01305.s: Who was the last Chief Minister of Andhra State?
aph-1277b01305.x: Tanguturi Prakasam was the first and Bezawada Gopala Reddy the second and last Chief Minister of Andhra State.

aph-009fd768e6.s: What was the official language of the Eastern Chalukyas?
aph-009fd768e6.x: The official language of the Eastern Chalukyas was Sanskrit, as it was for the Vishnukundins, Kakatiyas and Reddis; the Satavahanas and Ikshvakus used Prakrit.

aph-e39c9bf13b.s: Which of the following was the capital of the Ikshvakus?
aph-e39c9bf13b.x: The Ikshvaku capital was Vijayapuri in the Nagarjunakonda valley.

aph-b20ede31e9.s: Where was the headquarters of Andhra University when it was first established?
aph-b20ede31e9.x: Andhra University was started in 1926 with its headquarters at Bezawada; it was later shifted to Waltair (Visakhapatnam).

aph-19b9133382.s: Where was the first meeting of the Rayalaseema Mahasabha, formed in 1934, held?
aph-19b9133382.x: The first meeting of the Rayalaseema Mahasabha was held in Madras on 28 January 1934 under Nemali Pattabhirama Rao.

aph-95451dc03d.s: Who was the first secretary of the Andhra wing of the Socialist Party?
aph-95451dc03d.x: Madduri Annapurnaiah was the first secretary of the Andhra Socialist Party formed in 1934, with N.G. Ranga as its president.

aph-977d89046f.s: The Amaravati stupa was built during whose reign?
aph-977d89046f.x: The Amaravati Mahastupa was built and enlarged mainly under the Satavahanas.

aph-5b2abd4698.s: In Andhra, who was appointed Dictator of the Civil Disobedience Movement?
aph-5b2abd4698.x: Konda Venkatappayya was appointed dictator of the Civil Disobedience Movement in Andhra.

aph-c5f3c2086c.s: Where is the Parasurameswara temple, considered to be the oldest Shiva temple?
aph-c5f3c2086c.x: The Parasurameswara temple at Gudimallam (Yerpedu mandal, Chittoor) houses the world's oldest known Shiva linga.

aph-158d251a3c.s: On which day did Potti Sriramulu start his fast unto death for the formation of Andhra State?
aph-158d251a3c.x: Potti Sriramulu began his fast on 19 October 1952 at Bulusu Sambamurthy's house in Madras and died on 15 December 1952 after 58 days.

aph-9d77d46d56.s: During which movement did Tanguturi Prakasam gain the title 'Andhra Kesari' by showing his bravery?
aph-9d77d46d56.x: During the 1928 Simon Commission protest in Madras, Prakasam bared his chest before police guns and earned the title 'Andhra Kesari'.

aph-7772cd9cbe.s: Identify the first president of the Hyderabad State Congress among the following.
aph-7772cd9cbe.x: Govinda Rao Nanal was the first president of the Hyderabad State Congress.

aph-5db1aeebf5.s: In 1932, a committee was appointed by the Nizam of Hyderabad under the chairmanship of Aravamudu Iyengar. The committee was especially formed to suggest reforms in which sector?
aph-5db1aeebf5.x: The Aravamudu Iyengar committee was appointed to suggest political (constitutional) reforms in Hyderabad State.

aph-d850c71045.s: Which was the first book published in Telugu?
aph-d850c71045.x: Benjamin Schultze's Telugu translation of the Bible was the first book printed in Telugu.

aph-37c471dbb8.s: Who wrote the book 'At the Feet of the Master'?
aph-37c471dbb8.x: 'At the Feet of the Master' was written by Jiddu Krishnamurti when he was about 14 years old.

aph-5674c5dfe6.why: Options 3 and 4 belong to another question; only 3 real options survive.

aph-c1a3810a27.s: Where was the headquarters of the Dutch East India Company's settlements in India?
aph-c1a3810a27.x: The Dutch moved their Coromandel headquarters from Pulicat to Nagapattinam in 1690.
aph-c1a3810a27.key: corrected: book's own answer key gives option 1; Dutch HQ was Nagapattinam, not Porto Novo

aph-a7f143ebfc.s: Where is the C.P. Brown Memorial Trust Library in Andhra Pradesh?
aph-a7f143ebfc.x: The C.P. Brown Memorial Library is at Kadapa, where Brown served.
aph-a7f143ebfc.key: corrected: the library is at Kadapa, not Kakinada

aph-51c022871a.s: Sangama, the father of Harihara and Bukkaraya, the founders of the Vijayanagara Empire, was?
o: A king of Vengi Chalukya descent
aph-51c022871a.x: The Sangama family claimed descent from the Yadava (lunar) race.

aph-0f9e4258f2.s: Who among the following shifted the Bahmani capital from Gulbarga to Bidar?
aph-0f9e4258f2.x: Ahmad Shah Wali (Ahmad Shah I) shifted the Bahmani capital from Gulbarga to Bidar around 1425.
aph-0f9e4258f2.key: corrected: Ahmad Shah I moved the capital to Bidar, not Muhammad Shah-III

aph-64f7ade530.why: Option 4 is debris from other text; only 3 real options.

aph-66baea6a17.s: Which of the following pairs is incorrectly matched?
aph-66baea6a17.x: Buddhacharita was written by Ashvaghosha, not Nagarjuna; the other pairs are correct.

aph-710f2399e3.x: Amatyas were the ministers who advised the king.

aph-b595981cd3.s: Which of the following tells about local self-government during the Chola period?
aph-b595981cd3.x: The Uttaramerur inscriptions of Parantaka I describe Chola village self-government.

aph-0eccbcbd1d.s: With whom did the Rashtrakutas fight to capture Kanauj?
o: The Pratiharas and the kings of the Pala dynasty
aph-0eccbcbd1d.x: Kanauj was the prize of the tripartite struggle between the Pratiharas, Palas and Rashtrakutas.

aph-13d3f0cc73.s: Who among the following kings of Vijayanagara reconciled the conflict between Jains and Vaishnavas?
aph-13d3f0cc73.x: In 1368 Bukkaraya-I settled the dispute between the Jains and Srivaishnavas.

aph-63d8011977.s: What was the main cause of conflict between the Bahmani and Vijayanagara kings?
o: The Vijayanagara kings did not pay tribute to the Bahmanis
aph-63d8011977.x: Control of the fertile Raichur Doab between the Krishna and Tungabhadra caused repeated wars from the time of Harihara-I.

aph-fce02998bf.s: Which of the following does not belong to the subject matter of 'Amuktamalyada'?
o: Tells the story of Godadevi's marriage
Reveals the genealogy from Bukkaraya to Krishnadevaraya
aph-fce02998bf.x: Amuktamalyada narrates the marriage of Goda Devi (Andal) to Sri Ranganatha and contains statecraft (rajaniti); per the book, a genealogy from Bukkaraya is not part of it.

aph-0a10a7e1cb.s: Which of the following is not true about Gol Gumbaz?
o: It is the tomb of Muhammad Adil Shah
There is no mosque and no arches near the tomb
Its dome is one of the largest of its kind
aph-0a10a7e1cb.x: Gol Gumbaz at Bijapur, the 17th-century tomb of Muhammad Adil Shah, has a mosque attached to its complex.

aph-fec1fc0e1e.s: When did the 'Police Action' in Hyderabad end?
aph-fec1fc0e1e.x: Operation Polo ended with Hyderabad's surrender on 17 September 1948.

aph-5b32854083.s: Which musical instrument gained prominence during the Vijayanagara Empire?
aph-5b32854083.x: The veena gained prominence under Vijayanagara; Krishnadevaraya himself is said to have studied it.

aph-5dd1ce1c3c.s: Who first mentioned the forts in Andhra?
aph-5dd1ce1c3c.x: Megasthenes in his Indika (4th century BC) wrote that the Andhras had 30 fortified towns, a lakh of infantry, 2,000 cavalry and 1,000 elephants.

aph-9113e223fa.s: At Amaravati, Jaggayyapeta and Nagarjunakonda, stupas and viharas were built over whose remains?
aph-9113e223fa.x: These are Dhatugarbha stupas, built over the bodily relics of the Buddha.

aph-1c7343aacc.s: Who was the founder of the Tuluva dynasty?
aph-1c7343aacc.x: Veera Narasimharaya (1505-1509) founded the Tuluva dynasty.

aph-37cda0e9a4.why: Option 1 is truncated (title missing); pairs cannot be reliably reconstructed.

aph-50acdd8543.x: Vinukonda Vallabhamatya's Kridabhiramam describes the social life, sports and festivals of Orugallu (Warangal) in the Kakatiya period.

aph-b97c62f20f.s: Where did the French establish their first trade centre in Andhra in 1669?
aph-b97c62f20f.x: The first French settlement in Andhra was set up at Machilipatnam in 1669 with permission of Abdullah Qutb Shah.

aph-efd321d53f.s: Who was the founder of the Asaf Jahi dynasty in the Deccan?
aph-efd321d53f.x: Nizam-ul-Mulk Asaf Jah I founded the Asaf Jahi dynasty in 1724.

aph-61edcca63b.s: All inscriptions of the Satavahanas are?
o: In Prakrit language and Brahmi script
In Sanskrit language and Prakrit script
In Brahmi language and Devanagari script
In Brahmi language and Prakrit script
aph-61edcca63b.x: All Satavahana inscriptions are in the Prakrit language and Brahmi script.

aph-aea9a82010.s: What were gold coins called during the Kakatiya period?
aph-aea9a82010.x: Kakatiya gold coins were called Mada (Gadyana); Ruka was a silver coin.

aph-ac2641b19e.why: Options 2-4 are titles of English novels from another question; real options lost.

aph-d6e69718e0.s: Which was the first Telugu magazine published by the Bellary Christian Society?
aph-d6e69718e0.x: Satyadoota (1835) published by the Bellary Christian Society was the first Telugu magazine.

aph-4aec6c39e4.s: Who was the Satavahana emperor who enlarged the Amaravati stupa and built a stone railing around the Mahachaitya?
aph-4aec6c39e4.key: removed: book answer Srimukha (founder) is doubtful; the railing is usually credited to Vasishthiputra Pulumavi, not listed

aph-b38c05ae4b.s: In Andhra Pradesh, where is the C.P. Brown Memorial Trust Library located?
aph-b38c05ae4b.x: The C.P. Brown Memorial Library is located at Kadapa.

aph-3093cd3f63.why: Stem is debris; the actual question about Srinatha's titles is missing.

aph-9f821c9df2.s: What was known as the 'Athens of Vijayanagara'?
o: Present Bangalore, Kolar and Chittoor districts
Valley areas around the Virupaksha temple
aph-9f821c9df2.x: Per the book, the area around the Virupaksha temple at Hampi was known as the Athens of Vijayanagara.

aph-ff81b25a01.s: What Banabhatta was to Harsha's court, Vidyanatha was to?
aph-ff81b25a01.x: Vidyanatha, author of Prataparudra Yasobhushanam, was the court poet of Prataparudra, as Bana was of Harsha.

aph-1eae219723.s: Who among the following Nizam Prime Ministers collected the treasures of the magnificent Salar Jung Museum?
aph-1eae219723.x: Mir Yusuf Ali Khan (Salar Jung III) amassed the collection; the museum opened in 1951.

aph-3271876f1c.x: Duggirala Gopalakrishnaiah organised the Ramadandu volunteer force during the Chirala-Perala movement.

aph-81a137f31a.s: Who was the leader of the Chirala-Perala Satyagraha?
aph-81a137f31a.x: In 1921 the people of Chirala-Perala, led by Duggirala Gopalakrishnaiah, refused taxes and moved out of the town to Ramnagar.

aph-4e91a82f88.s: Kanneganti Hanumanthu was killed in which movement?
aph-4e91a82f88.x: Kanneganti Hanumanthu led the Palnadu Pullari (grazing tax) Satyagraha and died in police firing in 1922.

aph-b12fbbeb8f.s: Who was the leader of the No-Tax Campaign in Pedanandipadu?
aph-b12fbbeb8f.x: Parvataneni Veeraiah Chowdary, called the 'Andhra Shivaji', led the 1921-22 Pedanandipadu no-tax campaign with his Shanti Sena.

aph-13926a4b8c.s: What was the meaning of 'Gajabetekara' during the Vijayanagara period?
aph-13926a4b8c.x: Gajabetekara ('hunter of elephants') was a title of Deva Raya-II, the greatest of the Sangama dynasty.

aph-8735d08dc1.s: Who was Naganika, the wife of Satakarni-I?
aph-8735d08dc1.x: Naganika was the daughter of Maharathi Tranakayira; the marriage allied the Satavahanas with the Maharathis.

aph-1d6e193d13.s: Gunadhya wrote Brihatkatha in which language?
aph-1d6e193d13.x: Gunadhya wrote Brihatkatha in Paishachi; later Sanskrit versions include Somadeva's Kathasaritsagara and Kshemendra's Brihatkathamanjari.

aph-10f21c311f.s: In which battle did the Pallava Aparajitavarman defeat the Pandyas?
aph-10f21c311f.x: In the battle of Sri Purambiyam (c. 885) Aparajita defeated the Pandya Varaguna II.

aph-0e50d3a730.s: From which source can we know about local government and village administration of the Chola period?
aph-0e50d3a730.x: The Uttaramerur inscription of Parantaka I details Chola village administration and local government.

aph-2516884840.s: The colleges at Ennayiram and Tribhuvani (near Pondicherry) in South Arcot district were famous during which period?
aph-2516884840.x: The Ennayiram and Tribhuvani colleges were Vedic centres of the Chola period.

aph-8c111b4e70.s: Famous Sanskrit scholar of the time of the Devagiri Yadavas and author of Chaturvarga Chintamani?
aph-8c111b4e70.x: Hemadri, minister of the Yadava kings, wrote Chaturvarga Chintamani.

aph-4c6b982299.s: What was the mother tongue of the Devagiri Yadavas?
aph-4c6b982299.x: Per the book, the mother tongue of the Devagiri Yadavas was Marathi.

aph-7857427db0.x: Prataparudra Yasobhushanam, a work on alankara sastra, was written by Vidyanatha (Agastya), court poet of Prataparudra.

aph-1251b95850.s: Arab writers described which of the following as 'Ma'bar'?
aph-1251b95850.x: Arab writers called the Pandya kingdom Ma'bar.

aph-bc826d4e9c.x: In 1347 Alauddin Hasan Bahman Shah (Hasan Gangu) revolted against Muhammad bin Tughlaq and founded the Bahmani Empire.

aph-e875553ad6.s: Who were the first Vaishnavite devotees in South India?
aph-e875553ad6.x: The Alwars were the early Vaishnava saints of South India; the Nayanars were Shaiva.

aph-8afb22b600.s: Who was the Rajaguru of Sri Krishnadevaraya?
aph-8afb22b600.x: Vyasaraya was the rajaguru of Krishnadevaraya.

aph-6afb2e8177.s: Who had the title 'Yavana Rajya Sthapanacharya'?
aph-6afb2e8177.x: Krishnadevaraya took the title Yavana Rajya Sthapanacharya after restoring the Bahmani Sultan Mahmud Shah to his throne.

aph-406c6d9383.s: Who was the Sultan of Bijapur who fought at Raichur during the reign of Krishnadevaraya?
aph-406c6d9383.x: Krishnadevaraya defeated Ismail Adil Shah of Bijapur in the battle of Raichur (1520).

aph-784efd88c0.s: Where are colour paintings of the Vijayanagara period found in Andhra Pradesh?
aph-784efd88c0.x: The Veerabhadra temple at Lepakshi has the finest Vijayanagara-period ceiling murals in Andhra Pradesh.
